outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a plot presenting quantitative data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B shows representative fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C is a bar chart showing mean with 95% CI for lactate concentration across groups, and individual data points (colored dots for each region/replicate) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel D is a bar chart showing mean with 95% CI for lactate concentration in high vs low pH regions, and individual data points (colored dots) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel E is a schematic/model illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, not a plot presenting measured data, so individual data points are not applicable.
